Releases

Release notes for aterm, newest first. Each entry links its tag; the current download is on /aterm, and every release with its assets and .sha256 sidecars is on github.com/alabsystems/aterm/releases.

v0.63.0 · v0.61.0 · v0.60.0

v0.63.02026-08-28

Fixed

  • One kitty at a time. Sometimes a second cat was drawn on top of the cursor companion — two overlapping kitties.
  • The rainbow has no cyan in it. Blending green into blue used to pass through a saturated teal.

Added

  • Backspace, Space and Shift each have their own voice in the typing music.

v0.61.02026-08-26

Changed

  • The rainbow advances with your typing, and the highlighter is back behind the text.
